h0_role: structural prior, baseline, and fail-safe fallback; not a replacement for DNN
pre_registered_guard: relative to H0, residual should win at least two of calls MAPE, TV, and cost MAPE; cost MAPE may not regress by more than 10%, and bytes MAPE must be reported as a guard rather than hidden
prediction_freeze_rule: write predictions and freeze their SHA-256 before reading the matching confirmation Hfull targets
primary_architecture: H0 plus enhanced bounded residual DNN
